_meta.description: The ten connections Dossiq has to systems outside it, seeded for the Integrations page (pluggable-integration-registry). The status a row carries is the status the app can back on a fresh instance: eight are unconfigured because nothing has been saved or probed yet, and BRP and KvK are unavailable because they are specified and not built. NO ROW IS SEEDED configured — only a save or a probe may write that, which is what makes the page worth reading. The order follows row A34 of the round-2 placement matrix. settingsUrl points at the anchor its section carries in AdminRoot.vue. THREE rows carry none: BRP and KvK because they are not built, and PDOK because it has no admin section at all — its pdok_* app-config keys are read by the map components and written by nothing an admin can open. The change's design counted eight anchors; AdminRoot.vue has seven sections to anchor, and inventing a link into a section that does not exist is the one thing this page is here to stop.
